$comment: The manifest of an adapter (design §4): the machine form of the role list in core/contracts/<axis>.md. The structure is a subset of JSON Schema (see tools/lib/profile.mjs); `x-roles` lists the roles of each axis with their kind, which `harness check adapters` holds the manifest to: a required role must be filled, a role of the list may be left out only when its kind is optional, and a role the contract does not know is an error.

axis.description: The axis the adapter is on.

name.description: The adapter name, also the name of its folder.

contract.description: The version of the contract the adapter fills.

description.description: One sentence on what the adapter is for.

terms.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) of the words that belong to this adapter and must not appear in core; the CORE scan joins it with the term lists of the profile file.

roles.description: The roles the adapter fills: a role of the contract, and what fills it.

file.description: A file of the adapter that fills the role, relative to its folder.

module.description: The Node module of the adapter that holds the logic of the role, relative to its folder.

export.description: The function of that module (a logic role has a module and an export).

files.description: For the stack role "ignore-files": the files in which the formatter and the linters exclude paths. Each must exclude the vendored framework (`harness check scaffold`).

path.description: The ignore file, relative to the project root.

optional.description: True when the file may be missing (the project does not use that tool at its root).

templates.description: The template files the adapter provides, relative to its folder.
